The active archive is the upstream Vic UI build from commit `0b2952530f2a2ca5e538ed9b05a85856ebdde7d9`, stored as `vic-ui-0b29525.tgz`. Its SHA-256 is `d8b2750a79e771d8bbd1450b8a07f562580132f3740f9c49195dcecffe093666`.

It includes coordinated accent buttons, circular quiet/ghost buttons, the shared surfaces, and all native field exports used by Phaethon. The private compatibility port is retired. Phaethon maps its accent and inverse-text variables to `--button-accent` and `--button-on-accent` and opts into `tone="accent"`; it does not override the library's face gradients or round shapes.

To update, verify the supplied archive's checksum, copy it here with its source commit in the name, update the file dependency and lockfile with pnpm, then run the application build and behavioral checks. Keep the library's licence and third-party notices inside the archive. The upstream package contract is https://jerynv.github.io/vic-ui/docs/package-compatibility/ and the surface contract is https://jerynv.github.io/vic-ui/docs/surfaces/.

This release was packed from 54964b13, whose source tree is identical to merged 0b295253. It includes the 7de0c2c controls/layout release. It includes the b0a29e2 Office/media and 6deb7fc Combobox releases. It includes the ed35c65 controls increment. Shared switches opt into `look="flat"`. Button face radii derive from actual rim insets in the library; no consumer radius patch is needed.

Seven additive preview exports preserve the 123 historical exports. Phaethon uses ImagePreview (20 MiB encoded-byte cap), TextPreview (512 KiB/20,000 lines), DelimitedPreview (1 MiB/1,000 rows/60 columns), FilePreviewStatus and FilePreviewToolbar. The library renders ready Blob/Uint8Array inputs and owns its image URLs. Phaethon retains classification, permissions, loading/retry, native opening, PDF, syntax colours and academic Markdown. CSP permits blob images and media, without broadening script or frame sources. Preview source/provenance notices are retained in the archive.

The consumer gives the off-state flat switch a visible rimless fill and contrasting knob through existing colour tokens. Computed knob/track and track/group contrast are checked at >=3:1 in light/dark at both supported window sizes; this is a consumer colour adaptation, not a geometry or package patch. The issue and a suggested dedicated thumb token were sent to the Vic owner.

Six additive inline Combobox exports bring the root surface to 137 exports. The model picker uses actual ComboboxRoot, ComboboxSearch, ComboboxList, ComboboxItem and ComboboxEmpty. Phaethon owns filtering, accounts, asynchronous persistence and popup positioning; Vic owns active-descendant, keyboard/IME, pointer selection and scrolling. The temporary combobox controller is retired. Upstream postmerge CI and Pages run 41980999493 passed.

Five additive controls/layout exports brought the preceding root surface to 142 exports: Slider, SettingsLayout, SettingsSection, SettingsGroup and SettingsRow. Actual packed runtime imports preserve all 137 preceding exports, and typed consumer usage passes strict Bundler and NodeNext with skipLibCheck:false. Phaethon uses the scalar root Slider, native Radio, Settings headingProps and persistent Sidebar controllers as siblings of the transient sidebar presentation.

Office/media presentation loads through optional subpaths: `vic-ui/preview/media` (AudioPreview/VideoPreview), `vic-ui/preview/office` (XlsxPreview/PptxPreview), and `vic-ui/preview/docx` (DocxPreview). The DOCX adapter installs `docx-preview@0.4.1` explicitly. These renderers receive stable authorized bytes; no fetching, account or filesystem policy moves into the library. Phaethon's admission limits are 10 MiB for Office, 20 MiB for images, and 40 MiB for PDF/media. XLSX shows stored values, PPTX shows extracted slide text, and playback depends on native browser codecs. The imported text companion is a separate authorized fallback.

Twenty-four consumer browser checkpoints exercise real DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/WAV/WebM fixtures under native CSP, including loading, budgets and fallback. Optional parsers are split out of startup, and font assets emit as self URLs. The installed native window renders; physical native media playback and live account flows have not been exercised. Upstream library and docs CI/Pages run 42010810165 passed; its a7aff171 docs-only hydration correction does not replace this archive. Consumer evidence is recorded in `docs/workspace-redesign.md`.

The canonical controls increment adds 35 exports (177 total), preserving all 142 preceding names. Phaethon independently verifies the retained tarball checksum and safe entries, actual installed runtime exports, optional preview imports and both the historical and new typed consumers under strict Bundler/NodeNext with skipLibCheck:false. Existing app controllers and ready-byte loader boundaries remain intact. PaneViews, SettingsDialog, TimeField/TimePicker, Tree, RowButton and WrappingRow are available for focused future use; this compatible upgrade does not claim that every new control is used. The package adds React Aria/Stately time-field and motion dependencies; the lockfile records their exact resolved versions.
